description: 한국중부발전(주)_발전소 온배수정보 [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국중부발전(주). “온배수 정보” API는 한국중부발전(주)이 제공하는 공공데이터 서비스로, 발전소에서 배출되는 온배수 관련 문서 정보를 조회할 수 있는 기능을 제공합니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국중부발전(주). Its tags are 중부발전, 온배수, 환경, 수온관리, 배출. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-08-25 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
